Welcome to the '''Andah/Janus''' world-building project, a project to create an in-depth fictional world, from economics and culture to linguistics and history. The project began in mid-2024, while the wiki officially launched on 22 June 2025. Currently there are over [[Special:Statistics|{{NUMBEROFARTICLES}}]] articles, but there's an ambitious plan to expand this to over 1,000.

If this is your first visit, I hope you'll follow the project!

----

Andah is a fantasy/fictional world set in the year 1765, roughly a 2010s technology level for comparison. Some of the achievements so far include a complete history of the planet covering every year, an encyclopedia article for each of the 172 nations, economic data for every nation, oil reserves, and so much more.

Humans arrived on Andah 200,000 years ago. The exact location is still up for debate, but most agree it was most likely in southern [[Acrola]]. Andah's humans differ a lot from humans on Earth, since they have had enough time to evolve to the slightly different ecological zones of the planet.

Andah, or Janus as Earth calls it, is named after the Roman god of beginnings and doorways. It is located on the directly opposite side of the Sun to Earth, and orbits at the same distance from the Sun as Earth does. Scientists still don't understand how humans arrived on Andah. It is confirmed that they did not evolve there, as they have no connection to the organisms of the planet; some say it was extraterrestrials, possibly a higher power.

Politics-wise, the world is split into five main spheres of influence. The first is led by the Atirhan power of [[Raledria]] and its allies. [[Dahe]] leads the second in [[Massir]], [[Pelugrotoa]] leads the third in [[Mahea]], [[Areoix Lie]] leads the fourth in northern [[Acrola]], and the Quian Union leads the fifth in western [[Quia]].

International trade is settled in two reserve currencies: the [[Lahn|lahn]] ({{lahn}}) of [[Dahe]] and the [[Raledrian Kasare]] ({{Raledrian Kasare}}) of [[Raledria]]. [[Arraby]] is the most popular sport in the world, governed by the [[FLLA]] and its seven continental confederations; its main tournament, the [[FLLA World Cup]], is held every four years, and the [[1764 FLLA World Cup|most recent edition]] was hosted by Raledria and won by [[Easuhura]]. Seven [[:Category:Religions|religions]] are practised across the continents, each with its own denominations, and hundreds of [[:Category:Languages|languages]] are spoken.

----

If you'd like to join the project, the place to do it is the [https://discord.gg/277SzBGFG2 Andah Worldbuilding Institute] on Discord. Andah's canon is held centrally, because place names, population and economic figures and competition results have to stay consistent across thousands of pages, so it's worth asking there before editing straight away. The house rules are short: use British spelling, and don't invent proper nouns, since nations, cities, currencies and competitions almost always exist already. Where an article makes a factual claim, cite the established in-universe sources rather than new ones: the Global Trade Union for trade and economics, the World Data Union for population, the [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|Krali Development Report]] for development, and the [[FLLA]] for Arraby.

Not sure where to start? Visit a [https://andah.miraheze.org/wiki/Special:Random random page], press Shift+Alt+X, or [[Special:AllPages|browse everything]].

You can follow the project on [https://discord.gg/277SzBGFG2 Discord], [https://www.reddit.com/r/Andah/ Reddit], [https://www.deviantart.com/djmapping/ DeviantArt] and [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtqz9tLRgNh59FP9gDc59Uw YouTube]. There is also a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qeW5BDfvC0k History of Andah – Every Year] video.
